name: Avant

management.summary: Leasing staff praised as friendly, quick move-ins; community relations staffer praised. Some say requests go unanswered after move-in, slow phone/email replies; one recent Yelp review reports a late deposit return.

maintenance.summary: Mixed: positive mentions of maintenance, but some reports of unanswered requests and garage/key-fob problems.

cleanliness.summary: Pool, hot tub and amenities described as well maintained.

noise.summary: Most consistent complaint: thin walls/floors (hear neighbors and footsteps), freeway, Metro line and convention-center event noise.

security.summary: Controlled access; some mention homelessness nearby and garage/fob issues.

pests.summary: A few reports of pests; not a dominant theme.

costs.summary: Parking reported at about $100-$150/month, no guest parking; Essex company-level complaints about billing disputes and deposit delays (self-selected PissedConsumer reviews).

praise: location near LA Live, USC, convention center, Pico station
dealbreakers: Noise if you are noise-sensitive: thin walls plus freeway/Metro/convention-center noise come up repeatedly.
recent_trend: steady: large Yelp volume holds around 3.6; individual review dates were not visible in snippets

name: Glo
management_company: Unconfirmed (Equity Residential took over management in Dec 2011 and Yelp still links to Equity's site; an undated report says Berkshire Property Advisors bought it from a Holland Partners JV)

management.summary: Staff often called friendly and helpful; but 2025 ApartmentRatings reviews say repeated complaints went unresolved; office closed some days, package pickup limits.

maintenance.summary: 2025 reviews: long-broken elevator, frequent water shutoffs; May 2026 Yelp snippet about an unfixed dishwasher. Some praise individual maintenance staff.

cleanliness.summary: Some complaints about building cleanliness; pool and gym praised.

noise.summary: Noise from unit below cited in a 2025 review.

security.summary: Security and parking raised as concerns; Westlake/City West location.

pests.summary: No pest reports found in snippets.

costs.summary: No specific fee/RUBS info found; if Equity-managed, note Equity's LA RUBS billing disputes and late-fee settlement.

praise: walkable to LA Live, Metro, restaurants
dealbreakers: Recurring elevator outages and water shutoffs in 2025 reviews.
recent_trend: declining: the most recent reviews (2025-2026) lean negative on maintenance

name: Jia

management.summary: Leasing office generally called helpful; one 2025 ApartmentRatings review says a $600 deposit was never refunded after a rejected application (single unverified account).

maintenance.summary: On-site maintenance team frequently praised on Yelp; some report slow repairs and an elevator out for most of one 13-month lease.

cleanliness.summary: Equity-hosted reviews call it clean; one complaint of bad smell in parking area.

noise.summary: Some say building blocks outside noise; complaints about barking dogs and neighboring temple Chinese New Year celebrations.

security.summary: Reports of non-residents in pool area, no night patrol, homeless people around property, a gunman incident lockdown (2022-23), older garage break-ins (2014).

costs.summary: Equity-wide issues: LA RUBS utility billing disputes (Virgil Square, Mozaic), $43M late-fee class settlement; move-out fee complaints mentioned.

recent_trend: steady: Yelp count growing with mostly positive maintenance snippets; security complaints recur across years

name: Urban Village Apartments
management_company: Unconfirmed (past managers include Greystar, Bell Partners and E&S Ring per Yelp/Greystar listings)

management.summary: Repeated management changes 'and yet no improvements'; one said it went downhill after a March management switch; deposit withheld at move-out. A 2026 Apartments.com review is positive about management and upgrades.

maintenance.summary: Slow pest-control response in older reviews; Zumper summary credits a responsive maintenance crew.

cleanliness.summary: Mixed; residents differ on how considerate neighbors are in shared spaces.

noise.summary: Not a prominent theme in snippets.

security.summary: Broken gates, unlocked side/back doors, an intruder incident where staff could not use cameras; guard is for the medical office, not residents (2019-2022 reviews). One review says overnight security patrols.

costs.summary: No fee details; a 2021 review said Section 8 vouchers were not accepted.

praise: near Metro A Line and downtown Long Beach
dealbreakers: Recurring security complaints (broken gates, unlocked doors, intruder incident), though mostly from 2019-2022.
recent_trend: improving: the few 2026 reviews are positive, but too few to confirm

management.summary: Newer Yelp reviews praise specific staff; older reviews cite management problems and a deposit dispute.

maintenance.summary: A staff member praised for fixing problems quickly.

noise.summary: Thin walls and noise in older reviews (2008-2020).

security.summary: Gated two-level garage, but reports of broken gates/garage doors and car break-ins (incl. 10 cars in 2010, more in 2020).

name: Arancia

management.summary: All reviews found (mid-2025) describe unresponsive property manager, unanswered emails and texts.

maintenance.summary: Repair requests take weeks or months; maintenance staff described as dismissive.

noise.summary: No data; one mention of alarm triggers.

costs.summary: No data. No pets allowed per listing.

praise: building OK for the most part
dealbreakers: Every review found (small sample, 4 total) cites unresponsive management and very slow repairs.
recent_trend: unknown: only a handful of 2025 reviews

name: Thurman Lofts
management_company: Berkshire Communities (per ApartmentRatings FAQ, unverified); new management since Sept 2025 (prior: FPI, Laramar, Avenue5)

management.summary: Hard to reach managers; four management companies in a short period; 2026 prospect alleged a fair-housing issue over ID requirements (single account).

maintenance.summary: ApartmentRatings maintenance 1.0; elevator problems; pool/spa/gym sometimes unusable. One Laramar-era review praised fast disposal fix.

security.summary: Listing advertises 24-hour courtesy patrol; no resident data found.

pests.summary: Yelp reviewer found a cockroach daily for three months and was released from lease.

costs.summary: Listing shows $62 application fee, $500 deposit, $50/mo pet rent.

dealbreakers: Cockroach infestation report plus chronic management turnover and slow maintenance.
recent_trend: unknown: management changed Sept 2025; too few post-change reviews to judge

name: Metro 417

management.summary: Service cut: 24-hour concierge removed, everything via apps; windows not cleaned since 2022; billing problems. Some older reviews call staff 'like family'.

maintenance.summary: Elevators constantly breaking; one person trapped and fire dept called; one of three elevators left unrepaired.

cleanliness.summary: Window cleaning neglected; otherwise little data.

noise.summary: Thick concrete walls; described as quiet.

security.summary: Building break-ins, cars broken into, squatters and overdose deaths reported.

costs.summary: Renewal increase of about $80 cited; 2026 offer of a year of free parking (normally $175/mo).

praise: across from Grand Central Market and B/D Line
dealbreakers: Elevator reliability (one elevator left broken, entrapment) and building/garage break-ins.
recent_trend: declining: newer reviews describe cut services and unrepaired elevators

name: Fedora Flats

management.summary: New lease-up building (listing said 'Coming July 2026'); no resident reviews found.

costs.summary: Lease-up concession of up to 2 months free on 12-month leases (ForRent).

recent_trend: unknown: new building, no review history

name: Wilshire Vermont

management.summary: Management responds to most reviews; one unhappy leasing-office experience; Greystar company grade A- on ApartmentRatings.

maintenance.summary: Maintenance survey 4.3/5 and often quick, but a 2025 ice-maker leak flooded a unit and was unrepaired two weeks later; a 2026 reviewer reported conflict with maintenance.

noise.summary: Street noise and street conditions mentioned.

security.summary: Security staff described as friendly and attentive.

costs.summary: Repeated rent increases at renewal are the most consistent complaint (2026 and older).

praise: on top of Wilshire/Vermont Metro station
recent_trend: steady: 2026 reviews repeat rent-increase complaints; no major new issues

name: 616 Kenmore

management.summary: Concierge team described as warm and helpful.

cleanliness.summary: Small building that stays clean; modern and well kept.

security.summary: Secure garage; reviewers say it feels safer than other parts of Koreatown.

costs.summary: Water/sewer included; 8 weeks free on 15-month lease special.

recent_trend: unknown: positive overall; Yelp figure came from search snippets, not the business page, and review dates weren't visible

name: 104 Brookstone Apartments

management.summary: Recent Yelp praise for leasing office and building manager; one Apartments.com reviewer calls management pretty poor; history of management turnover and ownership sales (Cadigan, Calera, Western National).

maintenance.summary: Responsive maintenance noted by some; older complaints about broken AC and murky water.

noise.summary: Thin walls, pool-area and landscaping noise.

pests.summary: Termites, water bugs, crickets, silverfish reported (mostly 2009-2013, one more recent termites/water bugs mention).

recent_trend: improving: recent Yelp skews positive vs older ApartmentRatings negatives
